intro: Redridge Rendezvous is an Alliance rogue assignment dispatched from Stormwind's intelligence headquarters. Recognizing that raw recruits lack the finesse needed for dangerous field operations, SI:7 routes promising agents to Lakeshire to refine their tradecraft under seasoned operatives.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead rogue on his hands. Don't fret, though, friend - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.
Make your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, friend, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
